concerns.text: FR-001 mandates Band Gap and Formation Energy from OQMD and Thermal Conductivity from AFLOW. T002 fetches matbench_expt_gap, matbench_mp_e_form, and boltztrap_mp via matminer — none from OQMD or AFLOW. The task silently rewrites the mandated data sources without a spec amendment; this is a semantic weakening of FR-001 the deterministic check cannot catch. Either amend FR-001/SC-005 to name the actual sources or fetch the spec's sources.

T006 runs Wilcoxon on 'per-sample errors (abs_error)' but the contract it must conform to restricts metric_type to enum {calibration_error, sharpness}. As written, T006's output rows cannot validate against stats.schema.yaml — the task's verification step will fail or the implementer will silently emit non-conforming values. Align the tested quantity (per-sample abs_error vs per-sample interval-width/coverage indicators) with the contract enum, or extend the contract.

Principle VII requires computational cost metrics to 'show statistically significant differences to claim superiority.' T004 only records cost_metrics.csv; T006 tests only error-based metrics. No task performs paired testing on cost differences, so any cost-based superiority claim in T010's results account would violate the constitution. Extend T006 to cost metrics or explicitly scope T010's claims to exclude cost superiority.

Spec assumes test set size ≥ 100 for conclusive statistical tests; T003's thin run uses 100 total rows (~15 test samples). Acceptable as a smoke test only if explicitly marked exempt from the statistical-validity floor — T003 should state that no statistical conclusions are drawn from the thin run.

Plan mandates outputs under results/ (e.g., results/uq_methods.csv, results/pipeline_log.csv); all tasks write to data/results/. T008/T010/T011 verify artifact paths, so the divergence makes the plan's layout constraint unverifiable. Pick one canonical location and update plan or tasks.
